objective: A recognizable faceless Saudi TikTok story that makes the product understandable by second 3, demonstrates its contents, then gives one readable purchase action.
creative_concept: The character turns a clutter of floating fitness choices into a clear book-and-app routine; use the original character silhouette and restrained, continuous motion to connect each scene.

structure.visual: Open on the recognizable faceless character with one compact confusion motif. Bring the real book cover and an actual app screen into frame by second 2; keep the character visible as the bridge.
structure.narration: Select an intact, attention-catching fragment from the uploaded narration after transcription and source-timecode verification. Do not write or synthesize a replacement line.
structure.caption: Use a short verbatim Arabic caption for the chosen fragment.

structure.visual: Enlarge the real PDF cover and one actual interior page with useful content; label the product clearly as a digital PDF plus app. Show the 34-page format and 4-day/5-day program choices with a single restrained menu transition.
structure.narration: Use a complete existing fragment that introduces the product or training offer. If absent, preserve source narration continuity and communicate these verified details visually.
structure.caption: Readable visual labels may say دليل PDF رقمي • 34 صفحة and برامج 4 أو 5 أيام; keep them separate from verbatim speech captions.

structure.visual: Demonstrate the real app with a controlled scroll or authentic recorded interaction through its recipe list. Hold one recipe view long enough to recognize its content. Label screenshots as عرض توضيحي when used.
structure.narration: Reuse only an existing relevant source fragment, retaining its original pitch and natural breath boundaries. Do not fabricate a spoken 500-recipes claim if it is absent.
structure.caption: Show 500 وصفة في التطبيق as factual visual copy and show القيم الغذائية تقديرية alongside the nutrition display.

structure.visual: Return the character beside the book and app in one composed frame. Simplify the earlier clutter into the demonstrated program and recipe choices; avoid invented before/after physique transformations.
structure.narration: Use the source explanation or transition fragment if available; a brief clean pause is preferable to a newly invented line.
structure.caption: Summarize the demonstrated bundle in one short visual label; no promised physique, medical precision, or guaranteed result.

structure.visual: Hold a clean brand/product card with the original character, book/app identifiers, owner-supplied 15.99 ر.س price, and a single readable CTA. Finish with at least 3 uninterrupted seconds of the settled layout.
structure.narration: Use an intact source closing fragment only if it remains accurate. If old spoken pricing contradicts 15.99, omit that fragment without changing syllables or generating new speech.
structure.caption: 15.99 ر.س and اطلب بروتوكول التحول; the destination is the verified product URL from the packet.

prioritized_acceptance_checks.check: Every spoken segment is mapped to original-video in/out timecodes; no newly composed spoken lines, voice impersonation, pitch change, or word-level assembly that changes meaning.
The real product appears by second 3, and a viewer can identify the digital PDF plus app bundle before second 9.
All factual visual claims match the packet: 34 pages, 4/5-day programs, 500 recipes, estimated nutrition, and owner-supplied 15.99 SAR. No implication that store settings were edited.
Captions are correct Arabic, track the actual speech, stay inside a protected TikTok text area, and never collide with app content, price, or CTA.
Actual app/PDF evidence is recognizable at phone viewing size; transitions serve understanding and do not replace useful viewing time.
The last 3 seconds hold one settled CTA and price. No music; purposeful effects remain subordinate to narration.
Final delivery is 25–32 seconds, 1080×1920, true 60fps, and supplied with a working downloadable player link.

limitations: No final candidate or source-fragment transcript/timecode inventory was reviewed in this planning phase; narration slots are selection instructions, not claims that specific spoken lines exist.
No human listening capability; technical checks and ASR cannot establish subjective vocal naturalness. Final evidence must retain that limitation.
No approval, sales-performance claim, or final score is issued during planning.
Security infrastructure, legal certification, store configuration, and software changes are outside this content-creation review scope.
